fable.w: This section only rescinds $14,635,000 of previously appropriated funds under Public Law 103–327. There is no tempting reading here: it contains no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any decision.

opus.w: This provision only rescinds previously appropriated funds. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue that would bring outside parties into a federal decision. It is a plain budgetary measure, so it does not involve participation.
opus.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–327, $14,635,000 are rescinded.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a simple appropriation rescission. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or comment periods mentioned. The action is purely internal to the legislative budget process.
qwen_chat.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–327, $14,635,000 are rescinded.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that rescinding funds is a "decision" and therefore any process leading to it involves participation. However, the text itself contains no mention of any process, consultation, hearing, or interaction with outside parties. It is a unilateral legislative action regarding budget numbers.
